views.name: problem_step_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT L1_model AS problem, step, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
FROM model
GROUP BY L1_model, step
views.description: aggregates the number of occurrences for each problem within each step, forming a cohort of problem-step pairs with their counts.

views.name: qualifying_problems
views.body_sql: SELECT p.problem FROM problem_step_counts p JOIN model_score m ON p.problem = m.name AND p.step = m.step GROUP BY p.problem
views.description: joins problem occurrence counts with step-version score validity flags, applies the occurrence threshold filter, and extracts the qualifying problem identifiers.
